description: This PHP test class `EmployeeDistributionByLocationAPITest` tests the `EmployeeDistributionByLocationAPI` class's API endpoints related to employee distribution by location in the OrangeHRM Dashboard Plugin. It contains test methods for 'getAll' API endpoint as well as placeholders for 'create', 'delete', and their validation rules, although those methods are expected to throw not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionByLocationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeDistributionByLocationAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM Dashboard Plugin. It extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and includes tests for 'getAll' method and placeholders for 'create' and 'delete' related methods, verifying proper exception handling for unimplemented features.
